slack._comment: Team Zissou workspace only. Claude Code holds one Slack connection at a time — every Slack MCP server shares the same OAuth clientId, so authing a second workspace overwrites the first token, and a second server on the same URL shadows the plugin's server in the app. Skye High therefore can't be scanned automatically; see manualCheck below.

gmail._comment: queries cover the whole inbox, read and unread, so nothing is missed. cleanup is a separate, wider sweep used only by the newsletter cleanup pass.

cleanup._comment: Newsletter cleanup. Trashes bulk marketing mail only, and only when it passes every keep test in the triage skill's <inbox_cleanup> section. Trash is recoverable in Gmail for 30 days.

neverDelete._sendersComment: Always keep. Newsletters here are read for pleasure, not scanned for actions, so the usual 'no action needed' test does not apply to them.

cleanup._learnedKeepComment: Senders the user has rescued from a previous cleanup run. Append the sender address when the user says a trashed newsletter should have been kept; never remove an entry automatically.
